title: A Huge Chinese Model at a Tiny Price! 🇨🇳
body: A Huge Chinese Model at a Tiny Price! 🇨🇳

On November 18, Chinese company Tencent announced its new Hy4 Flash model — a huge AI model that is cheap to run. The model has 224 billion parameters — a parameter is a unit of learning inside a model — but with each question, only 12 billion of them are active, which is what makes it fast and cheap.

The model supports text and image input, and remembers context of up to one million tokens. Its price is about $0.070 per million input tokens and $0.281 per million output tokens, and Tencent says the cost of a single task is one-eighth the cost of the rival DeepSeek model.
The model is available free on the WorkBuddy platform until November 30, and Tencent plans to open its weights to developers.
Does a low price change your mind about Chinese models? 💡
